g.card: Cinca swihundzuluxi u kongomisa kalichi yin’wana na yin’wana ya migodi eka vuhumelo bya muvala wa yona.
g.genre: Ntlangu wa phazili wa swiporo na tikalichi
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: tiphazili ta 90 ta swiporo eka mabako ya 6 ya kristale. Cinca swihundzuluxi u kongomisa kalichi yin’wana na yin’wana eka vuhumelo bya muvala wa yona.
g.h2: Phazili ya swiporo eka mabako ya xinomi
g.p1: Tikalichi ti huma eka thanele ti famba hi toxe. Cinca swihundzuluxi leswaku yin’wana na yin’wana yi fika eka vuhumelo bya muvala wa yona yi nga hlangani.
g.p2: Swiyimo swa 90 eka mabako ya 6: tilivha, mabiriji lama hundzulukaka, ayisi, mati lama tlakukaka na lava. Kuma tinyeleti ta 3 hi mafambiselo ma nga ri mangani, xinomi xi ku pfuna loko u khomiwile.
l.card: Hundzuluxa swivoni, kongomisa marhanzi ya ku vonakala u tlhela u vonakarisa tikamara ta 150 ta khokholo.
l.genre: Ntlangu wa phazili wa swivoni na ku vonakala
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: hundzuluxa swivoni u kongomisa ku vonakala eka tikristale eka swiyimo swa 150 na misava ya 6 leyi pendiweke.
l.h2: Phazili ya ku vonakala eka khokholo ra masalamusi
l.p1: Khokholo ri ve munyama. Hundzuluxa swivoni na tikamara ku kongomisa marhanzi eka tikristale: loko hinkwato ti vangama, nyangwa wa nsuku wa pfuleka.
l.p2: Swiyimo swa 150 eka misava ya 6: mivala yo pfanganyisa, magilasi ya mivala, tiphrizimi, swifaniso na tigiya. Swikombiso, na tinyeleti ta 3 eka xiyimo xin’wana na xin’wana eka lava tlhariheke.
l.f1: Swiyimo swa 150 eka misava ya 6 leyi pendiweke
l.f2: Swivoni, tiphrizimi, magilasi ya mivala na tigiya
d.card: Tsutsuma, haha u hefemula ndzilo eka mimfumo ya 7 ya masalamusi na tibosi ta yona ta 7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: ntlangu wa pulatifomo wa 2D lowu pendiweke hi voko. Tsemakanya mimfumo ya 7, swiyimo swa 63 na tibosi ta 7 ku hlongola Hosi ya Swirhendzevutani.
d.h2: Vuhlapfa bya pulatifomo eka mimfumo ya 7
d.p1: Tlanga u ri dragona leritsongo ra rihlaza ra xivindzi. Tsutsuma, tlula, haha u hefemula ndzilo ku hlongola Hosi ya Swirhendzevutani.
d.p2: Mimfumo ya 7, swiyimo swa 63 na tibosi ta 7, yin’wana na yin’wana yi na vutlhari bya yona. Hlengeleta tikristale u kuma ku fikela eka tinyeleti ta 3 eka xiyimo xin’wana na xin’wana.
d.f2: Tibosi ta 7 to hlula, yin’wana na yin’wana hi vutlhari bya yona
t.card: Tsema, hundzuluxa u veka mapapa ku pfulela muthungi lontsongo ndlela.
t.genre: Ntlangu wa phazili wa mapapa na swivumbeko
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: tiphazili ta 240 eka swifundzha swa 12 swa tilo. Tsema, hundzuluxa u veka mapapa ku pfula ndlela.
t.h2: Ntlangu wa phazili wo rhula etilweni
t.p1: Swihlala swi phaphamela etilweni naswona nyangwa wa masalamusi wu rindzile. Tsema mapapa, ma hundzuluxe u ma veka ku aka ndlela ya muthungi lontsongo.
t.p2: Swiyimo swa 240 eka swifundzha swa 12 leswi pendiweke, handle ka nkarhi. Kuma tinyeleti ta 3, pfula mabokisi u hlengeleta mapapa.
w.card: Veka tigiya, yisa matimba u pfuxa mfumo lowu etleleke.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: tiphazili ta 150 ta michini eka misava ya 6 ya mintsheketo. Veka tigiya u yisa matimba ku sungula michini nakambe.
w.h2: Ntlangu wa phazili wa tigiya ta xiviri
w.p1: Ndzhukano wu gwitsirile mfumo. Veka tigiya endhawini leyinene ku yisa matimba ya njhini ya masalamusi u sungula michini nakambe.
w.p2: Swiyimo swa 150 eka misava ya 6: tirune, tilivha, marhanzi ya kristale na wachi wa sava. Kuma tinyeleti ta 3 u vona mimapa yi tlhela yi kuma mivala ya yona.
u.card: Veka swiphemu swa tirune leswi waka u hlengeleta tirune ta muvala wun’we leswaku ti nyamalala.
u.genre: Ntlangu wa phazili wa swiphemu leswi waka
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: veka swiphemu swa tirune leswi waka, hlengeleta mivala u hlanganisa tikhombo eka swiyimo swa 180 na swifundzha swa 6.
u.p1: Swiphemu swa tirune swi wela ehenhla ka bodo. Swi famba u swi hundzuluxa ku hlengeleta tirune ta muvala wun’we: ti nyamalala naswona hinkwaswo swi wela ehansi.
u.p2: Swiyimo swa 180 eka swifundzha swa 6, ku suka eka Xihondzo xa N’anga ku ya eka Khokholo ra Tilo. Hlanganisa tikhombo ku kuma tinyeleti ta 3.
n.card: Kongomisa dragona, dya tirune u kula u nga lumi ncila wa wena.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: ntlangu wa nyoka na dragona. Dya tirune, papalata swihinga u hlula varhangeri va 6 eka swiyimo swa 120.
n.p1: Dragona a ri yimi nikatsongo. Kokisa ritiho ku ri hundzuluxa, dya tirune ku kula u papalata makhumbi na miri wa wena.
n.p2: Swiyimo swa 120 eka swifundzha swa 6, xin’wana na xin’wana xi rindziwa hi bosi. Tirune ta masalamusi ti hunguta nkarhi, ti ku endla xipoko kumbe ti ku sirhelela.
n.f2: Tirune ta masalamusi ta matimba yo hambana
